title: Platform Engineering, Internal Developer Platforms & Crossplane
summary: Design Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) as a product: Golden Path templates, Backstage software catalogs, and Crossplane universal cloud control planes.
learningObjectives: Provision self-service cloud infrastructure using Crossplane Composite Resource Claims.
Standardize Golden Path microservice deployments with compliant platform metadata.
Reduce cognitive load for application teams through declarative platform APIs.

curriculumModules.title: Platform as a Product & Golden Paths
curriculumModules.conceptSummary: Platform Engineering reduces developer cognitive load by providing paved 'Golden Paths'—self-service templates with built-in CI/CD, observability, security, and GitOps.
curriculumModules.productionArchitecturePattern: Expose a Backstage portal backed by GitOps templates and Kubernetes Custom Resources so teams can launch compliant services in minutes.

curriculumModules.title: Crossplane: Kubernetes-Native Universal Cloud Control Plane
curriculumModules.conceptSummary: Crossplane lets platform teams define `CompositeResourceDefinitions` (XRDs) and `Compositions` so developers can claim cloud databases, queues, and buckets via standard `kubectl apply`.
curriculumModules.productionArchitecturePattern: Provide namespace-scoped Crossplane Claims (`PostgresInstance`) that automatically compose VPC subnets, RDS/CloudSQL instances, and connection Secrets.

labs.title: Self-Service Database Provisioning via Crossplane Claim
labs.scenario: A product squad needs a compliant PostgreSQL instance in `production`. Provision the Crossplane claim `PostgresInstance` named `billing-rds-claim` and verify the platform controller reconciles its backing service.
labs.productionContext: With Crossplane, application teams request infrastructure using Kubernetes manifests without writing raw cloud IAM or VPC code.
objectives: Verify the reconciled database service `billing-rds-claim-db` has an active endpoint
labs.starterManifest:
apiVersion: database.kubelabs.io/v1alpha1
kind: PostgresInstance
metadata:
  name: billing-rds-claim
  namespace: production
spec:
  tier: production-ha
  storageGB: 200

steps.title: Verify Composed Database Endpoint
steps.instruction: Check that service `billing-rds-claim-db` was automatically provisioned in `production`.

validationRules.description: Composed Service production/billing-rds-claim-db has active endpoint
validationRules.name: billing-rds-claim-db
validationRules.remediation: Ensure billing-rds-claim is created in namespace production.

labs.troubleshootingGuide: Run `kubectl get postgresinstance,svc -n production` to confirm reconciliation.

labs.title: Onboarding a Golden Path Microservice with IDP Labels
labs.scenario: Deploy a Golden Path service `customer-portal` in `production` and label it with `platform.kubelabs.io/golden-path=enabled` for Backstage catalog discovery.
labs.productionContext: Backstage and platform controllers discover and govern services through standardized Kubernetes labels and annotations.
labs.starterManifest:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: customer-portal
  namespace: production
  labels:
    platform.kubelabs.io/golden-path: enabled
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: customer-portal
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: customer-portal
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: portal
          image: nginx:1.27-alpine

steps.title: Apply Golden Path Governance Label
steps.commandHint: kubectl label deployment customer-portal platform.kubelabs.io/golden-path=enabled -n production

validationRules.name: customer-portal
validationRules.remediation: Run `kubectl label deployment customer-portal platform.kubelabs.io/golden-path=enabled -n production`.

solutionCommands: kubectl label deployment customer-portal platform.kubelabs.io/golden-path=enabled -n production
labs.troubleshootingGuide: Check `kubectl get deploy customer-portal -n production -o json` to verify the label is present.

assessmentQuestions.question: How does Crossplane differ from traditional CLI-only Infrastructure-as-Code tools?
options: Crossplane runs as a continuous Kubernetes reconciliation loop inside the cluster, actively detecting and healing cloud drift
Crossplane only works with on-premises FTP servers
Crossplane requires writing infrastructure in assembly language
assessmentQuestions.explanation: Crossplane embeds cloud provider controllers inside Kubernetes, continuously reconciling cloud APIs against declarative CRDs rather than only running when a CLI command is triggered.

assessmentQuestions.question: What is a 'Golden Path' in Platform Engineering?
options: A mandatory ticket queue that requires 5 manual approvals
An opinionated, well-supported, self-service workflow that makes the secure and compliant way to ship software the easiest path for developers
A static network cable between two routers
A billing report exported at the end of the year
assessmentQuestions.explanation: Golden Paths abstract away infrastructure boilerplate while baking in security, observability, and GitOps best practices.
